== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Valinhall, also known as Valinhall [[House]], is a unique [[Territory]] that functions as a separate, isolated world. It is believed to be a shard of a previously larger and more complete world that was broken and drifted into nothingness. [[House|The House]] is characterized by its unpredictable nature, often rearranging its internal layout or adding new rooms to suit its inhabitants. Its geography defies standard logic; for example, a garden may consist of open plains under a sky despite being surrounded by indoor rooms, and certain areas like the forge may sit directly adjacent to libraries. While it contains various spaces such as an [[entry hall]] with mirrors and sword racks, a tiled courtyard, and several gardens that provide food and water, [[the House]] is notoriously difficult for travel. Entering Valinhall from another location typically results in a traveler returning to that same exact spot when they attempt to leave. [[The Territory]] was reportedly created approximately sixty years ago through a twisted experiment by [[Damasca]]. It was eventually claimed and named by a man known as [[Valin]], also called the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]], who arrived via a sudden flash of light and roar. [[Valin]] mastered [[the House]]'s many rooms, including deep reaches with unshaped powers that even long-term residents fear to enter. He also used his knowledge and collected texts to create a gate connecting Valinhall to the outside world. Valinhall is distinct from other Territories because of how its [[Travelers]] utilize power. Rather than summoning external weapons, beasts, or elemental magic to fight, a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] summons power into themselves to win battles. This makes them exceptionally well-equipped for combat against other Territories. [[House|The House]] is governed by the principle of force, and its inhabitants face constant testing, as the environment itself can attack or attempt to kill them to ensure they remain perpetually vigilant. The [[Travelers]] are a rare and dwindling group following a historical conflict between [[Valin]] and [[Damasca]].}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Located behind the [[entry hall]], Valinhall is a house and [[Territory]] that contains an entire world within its walls, including open plains, a forge, a library, a garden, and a long blue-lit basement. Once a complete world featuring cities, trees, and a sun, it was broken into a shard where time flows slower than in the outside world. The environment is entirely hostile, utilizing attacks against its inhabitants as a method of teaching. [[Simon]] eventually settled into life there, drawing essence and [[Traveler]]'s gifts from the house to gain its strength and speed. While [[Simon]] can reach this realm through his sword, he cannot escape by [[Traveling]] because the Gate returns a person to their starting point.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Created sixty years ago as an experiment by [[Damasca]], Valinhall is a [[House]] and [[Territory]] that serves as a source of power for [[Indirial]] and certain individuals capable of wielding [[Mithra]]. This location functions as a repository where [[the Nye]] repair and store weapons, though it is reputed to be useless for rapid travel. While its [[Travelers]] excel in open combat, they lack versatility, and the territory is highly effective at destroying foreign [[Travelers]]. Within this realm, which contains a [[healing pool]] and two women including [[Angeline]], [[Simon]] traveled to seek healing and has partially conquered the area. Although a Gate opened from Valinhall returns to its original starting point, such as the stone temple in the [[Badari Desert]], the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]] would never choose to enter this place. As the world begins to shape itself into a harsh, combat-filled environment similar to Valinhall, the location remains deeply associated with [[Incarnations]] and [[Travelers]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Valinhall is a magnificent new [[Territory]] designed to challenge those with great power and serve as a place for killing other [[Travelers]]. This location features an entry room with a wooden rack, a courtyard of gray stone, and a room dedicated to honoring the dead. While it can be used to summon weapons or draw internal power to strengthen the body, users must pay their debts to enjoy these benefits. Despite being a place where constant vigilance is required, [[the House]] has faced an invasion by the [[King of Ragnarus]] and is currently falling apart. Ultimately, [[Simon]] serves as the leader of Valinhall, a [[Territory]] that maintains a two-way bond with those connected to it.}}
